text_simplified: Ibn al-Qayyim (may Allah have mercy on him) warned against neglecting to teach a child the obligations and Sunnahs of the religion and leaving him aimless. He explained that most corruption in children comes from parents neglecting them when they were young. Along with taking all legitimate means in upbringing, parents must rely upon Allah alone and attach their hearts to Him, for guidance belongs to Him alone.
